## Kid-safety checklist (delete this section if collection-wide docs only)

- [ ] No external URLs, network calls, `eval`, or dialogs added
- [ ] No free-text input outside the Lab code box (parsed, never rendered)
- [ ] Fail states stay gentle; no ads, timers, streaks, or purchases
- [ ] Buttons remain ≥44px; text readable in every theme
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_games.py` passes
